notes: Events fetched via BotProbe /trace — full ES stream, not Mongo AssistantEvent.
Mongo AssistantEvent holds kb_bot MONGO_PERSISTED_EVENT_TYPES subset only; missing LLM/token types.
Sample window: voice sessions with start_time in last 14 days per tenant.

session_index.name: AssistantSession
session_index.role: List/filter sessions; voice_session_id (UUID) is BotProbe /trace input.

event_trace.name: BotProbe /trace API
event_trace.role: Full ordered event log per session (backed by Elasticsearch).

mongo_assistant_event.name: AssistantEvent
mongo_assistant_event.role: NOT used for Ypervaíno materialization — incomplete type subset only.
mongo_assistant_event.note: See mongo_persisted_subset below; use for reconciliation/debug only.

optional_transcript.name: SessionRequest
optional_transcript.role: Turn-level transcript enrichment optional; derive transcript from trace events by default.

trace_event_envelope.description: Normalized ES log document returned by BotProbe /trace (fields promoted from json.data).

core_fields.content: string | null — user/bot text or log line (from logged_event)
core_fields.event_value: object | null — structured metadata; paths in event_types.*.event_value_paths
core_fields.secs_since_session_start: number | null — ES dedup aid in reconciliation

trace_event_envelope.turn_grouping: Group by request_id for turn-level events (USER_QUERY, RESPONSE.FINAL, LLM_*, TOOL_*).
deduplication_notes: Duplicate SESSION_END on reconnect (voice_session.reconnects >= 1): keep first chronologically.
Do NOT dedupe DEBUG.SKILL_ROUTED or routing events by request_id alone.
ES log shipper may re-send identical lines; BotProbe reconciliation dedupes on secs_since_session_start.

RESPONSE.FINAL.content_semantics: Bot final response text in content

observed_event_types._description: All event_type values seen in the trace sample, with counts.

infrastructure_event_types._description: High-volume pipeline/internal types in trace; usually excluded from measurement primitives.
